about: A word list for IRL streaming, one entry per term. Fields: id (an anchor), term, aliases, tier (core | more), who (streamer | helper | both), heard_when, plain, related (ids), source, uncertain, and optional l10n: {<language tag>: {term, plain, heard_when}} such as es-419 or pt-BR. Translations keep the scene's English terms as the term and explain in the language, and are read by a native speaker before publishing. Validated by the zod schema in ../schema.

words.heard_when: Streamers talk about going live away from their desk, whether that's in the kitchen, at a venue or on the street.
words.plain: Short for "in real life". It means streaming your real life away from your desk or gaming setup: in the kitchen at home, at a venue, outside or on the move.
